Vienna Doctoral Schools
Doctoral Schools at the University of Vienna offer excellent conditions for pursuing ambitious research, including team-based supervision and a range of funding opportunities. As a PhD student, you will become part of an active and inspiring research environment and a vibrant PhD community. You will have numerous opportunities to connect and exchange ideas with fellow researchers from Austria and around the world, build your academic network, and engage in an internationally connected research community.
